company.name: Fredun Pharmaceuticals
company.ownership: This profile covers Fredun Pharmaceuticals Limited, a Mumbai-based company listed on BSE. It makes medicines and health products in its own factory, and also runs newer consumer and pet-health brands. Several of those brands, such as Freossi, BeautyFred and DAULCÉL, are product names and not separate listed companies.
products: Products sold under another company’s name
Food-supplement brands such as Mamalait and Fredmax
Skin products with added active ingredients
sources: FY 2025–26 annual report (company website, http only)
Fredun Group investor page (company website, http only)

The other cards remain labelled original illustrations because no suitable photograph was found.
